parsed.name: FireSting 多通道光学氧测量仪
parsed.description: FireSting 是一类用于连接光学氧传感器的多通道氧测量仪，可对液体或气体样品中的氧信号进行光学测量，并结合温度、压力和盐度参数进行补偿计算。它常用于实验室中的溶解氧、氧饱和度和相关氧参数监测。
parsed.description_en: The FireSting is a multi-channel optical oxygen meter designed to work with optical oxygen sensors. It performs optical oxygen measurements in liquid or gas samples and can apply temperature, pressure, and salinity compensation. It is commonly used in laboratories for dissolved oxygen, oxygen saturation, and related oxygen monitoring.

actions.description: 测量设备所有通道的氧信号及相关补偿参数。
actions.description_en: Measure oxygen signals and related compensated values on all device channels.

actions.description: 获取/设置各通道测量光源的 LED 强度。
actions.description_en: Get/set the LED intensity of the measurement light source for all channels.

actions.description: 获取/设置各通道的测量时间。
actions.description_en: Get/set the measurement time for all channels.

actions.description: 获取/设置各通道的信号放大倍数。
actions.description_en: Get/set the signal amplification for all channels.

actions.description: 获取/设置各通道的调制频率。
actions.description_en: Get/set the modulation frequency for all channels.

actions.description_en: Flash the device logo and trigger an optical measurement on all channels to help identify the device.
